readme:
# Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Part Splitter
Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Part by Tencent splits an FBX 3D model into its separate parts and returns one FBX file per part.
## Fields
| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_url` | string, required | — | URL of the FBX model to split. FBX only, max 100MB, up to 30,000 faces. AI-generated models work best. |
## Output
- `url`: Main 3D file (GLB unless another export format is selected).
## Billing
$0.45 per request.
Failed runs are not charged.
## Also on SandBase
Other Tencent 3D endpoints: `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.0/image-to-3d`, `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.1/pro/image-to-3d`, `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.1/pro/text-to-3d`, `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.1/rapid/image-to-3d`.
